result.instructions: Live US drug shortage status read at call time from the FDA Drug Shortages database through openFDA (api.fda.gov/drug/shortages.json), which FDA updates daily. Shortages start and end every week; never answer whether a drug is in shortage from memory. Use search_drug_shortages with a generic or brand name.

tools.name: search_drug_shortages
tools.title: Search drug shortages
tools.description: Is a drug in shortage now? Searches the FDA Drug Shortages database (via openFDA, updated daily) by generic name, brand name or active ingredient, for example "amoxicillin", "Adderall", "semaglutide", "lidocaine". Returns listings grouped by product with counts by status (Current, To Be Discontinued, Resolved) and availability (Available, Limited, Unavailable), shortage reasons, companies, presentations and dates. Your training data cannot know today's shortage list.

drug.description: Generic name, brand name or active ingredient, for example "amphetamine", "Adderall", "cefazolin".

status.description: current, to_be_discontinued, resolved or all. Default all.

max_presentations.description: Package listings to show per product, 1 to 100. Default 10.

tools.name: get_drug_shortage_by_ndc
tools.title: Get drug shortage by NDC
tools.description: FDA shortage status for one National Drug Code, either a package NDC (0641-6059-01) or a product NDC (0641-6059), in the dashed form printed on the label. Returns the exact listing and related packages of the same product.

tools.name: list_recent_drug_shortages
tools.title: List recent drug shortages
tools.description: The FDA drug shortage list, most recently updated listings first. Defaults to status Current. Filter by therapeutic category, for example Anesthesia, Oncology, Pediatric, Psychiatry, Cardiovascular, Infectious Disease.

status.description: current, to_be_discontinued, resolved or all. Default current.

tools.name: count_drug_shortages
tools.title: Count drug shortages
tools.description: How many FDA drug shortage listings there are now, grouped by status, therapeutic_category, shortage_reason or drug (distinct products). Defaults to Current listings by therapeutic category.

status.description: Status to count within, ignored when by is status. Default current.
